recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. Further source wording would be redundant because the active source already conveys the accepted clarification and later MeasureReport refinements have their own issue history.
issue_request: FHIR-12950 asked CQI to clarify MeasureReport wording that described the resource as evaluating a measure or only referencing a measure. The final resolution was to use calculation-oriented language: the MeasureReport contains the report/results generated by calculation of a measure and resources involved in that calculation, and MeasureReport.measure is the measure calculated.
initial_application: Jira records SVN 13336, and git commit 09671045938ee85e38a331e9fac9927ca8c01cae (GF#12950) applied the change by updating MeasureReport narrative, resource definition, MeasureReport.measure short/definition, and related Measure evaluate operation wording from evaluation to calculation terminology.
additional_context: MeasureReport is active in source/fhir.ini. Later Published MeasureReport issues FHIR-17273 and FHIR-34033 refined evaluatedResource representation and bounded-data semantics, but they do not reverse FHIR-12950's calculation clarification; FHIR-34033 is already separately represented on the combined branch. Zulip and Confluence searches found no substantive community discussion changing the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: No source edit was needed. The current StructureDefinition says MeasureReport contains results of calculation of a measure and optional references to resources involved in that calculation, MeasureReport.measure is the measure calculated, and current narrative/operation text uses calculation-oriented subject wording.

related_jiras.note: Changed MeasureReport.evaluatedResources from a Bundle reference to repeated direct references, refining the resources-involved-in-calculation model without changing FHIR-12950's calculation wording.
Clarified evaluatedResource scope and is already represented by combined commit 8674eb228a67f1b3b07157036613f1faf9f0e994; it supports no additional FHIR-12950 source edit.
